Los Alamos National Laboratory plan LAMP-ENG-PLAN-003, by Joel Montross and issued May 18, 2026, sets requirements for the LAMP accelerator project's product data management vault. The vault is the controlled library where drawings and design files live, so that every part traces to an approved revision. The document defines vault behavior for the project team before configuration begins.

Rules cover watermarking: drawings carry grade-level watermarks locked against editing, and the default stamp at creation through approval reads Preliminary, Not for Fabrication. Release states and not-applicable assignments are defined for each object type. Systems engineering, mechanical leads, and the technical director reviewed and approved the plan. For a large accelerator project, such unglamorous rules prevent the classic failure of building from the wrong drawing.
